comparison_kind: Culsma execution and LabOP library/source audit

culsma.scope: Declared allocation and association, without downstream operations or hardware.
culsma.aggregate_limitation: The pinned runtime also reports 10.001 uL for the bound fraction and 100 mg for flowthrough via cross-dimension aggregate projections. These are not physical volume/density predictions and are excluded from the verified outcomes; this check uses dimensioned component quantities.
